description: Pretty Charts. REPLACE with what the service does, the request shape (POST JSON to /v1/<resource>), and the response shape (a JSON object; non-JSON output rides in a string field). State whether output is identical across suppliers.

rpc_types.backend_hint: pretty-charts HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/<resource>, GET /v1/version and GET /healthz are expected. Every response is a JSON object; non-JSON content is carried in a string field.

specs.notes: Version-addressed URL. Add sha256 (lowercase hex of the exact bytes) only once this URL is frozen.

serving.backend: REPLACE: what a supplier deploys, e.g. the pretty-charts container behind a RelayMiner with the rest backend pointed at it. No auth toward the backend; callers cannot send headers.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.

body.REPLACE: a minimal valid request with a known answer

healthcheck.notes: Functional probe with a deterministic expected value. Keep it cheap; gateways run it every cycle.

serving.notes: REPLACE: rate limits to disable for the RelayMiner's address, request sizes, timeouts. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"]; see sage-service.yaml.
